name: M.Sc. Mechanical Engineering
tuition_note: 6,000 € per semester for international (non-EU) students; student fees 97 € per semester
summary: 120 ECTS over 4 semesters; can be studied in German and English.

name: M.Sc. Mannheim Master in Management
summary: Fall intake only. 2027/28 application dates not yet confirmed on the official page (2026/27 window was 1 April – 15 May).

name: M.Sc. Physics
summary: Four-semester programme taught entirely in English, run jointly with the University of Cologne. Non-EU deadline 1 May (EU: 1 July); scholarship applications by 1 December of the previous year.

name: M.Sc. International Health
tuition_note: 14,100 € for the one-year full-time programme (part-time up to 5 years)
summary: One-year full-time programme starting in September at the Heidelberg Institute of Global Health.

name: Master of Public Policy
summary: Willy Brandt School of Public Policy. Priority deadline 28 Feb 2027; 30 Apr 2027 is the final deadline for applicants who need a visa (EU/EFTA: 15 Jul 2027). October intake.

name: LL.M. European and International Law
tuition_note: 3,400 € per semester (6,800 € for the academic year) plus the university semester fee
english_note: Sound knowledge of English (TOEFL, IELTS or CAE accepted)
summary: One-year LL.M. at the Europa-Institut, taught in English; some courses can be taken in German. Late applications until 30 September.

name: M.A. Integrated Design
summary: All courses taught in English. Requires a design bachelor's (180 ECTS from winter 2025/26) and 12 months of professional work experience after the bachelor's.

name: M.A. Modern Indian Studies
english_note: C1 English (IELTS Academic 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 95); an MOI letter alone is not accepted
summary: Taught entirely in English; no German required. Courses in a modern Indian language are part of the degree. Non-EU applicants apply 6 Oct – 15 Nov of the previous year.

name: M.Sc. Agricultural Sciences in the Tropics and Subtropics
summary: AgriTropics. Winter semester only. Non-EU applications open mid-November 2026 (start date shown as 15 Nov), deadline 15 March 2027 (EU/EEA: 15 September).

name: M.Sc. Integrated Urbanism and Sustainable Design (IUSD)
english_note: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 79 (per programme FAQ)
summary: Winter-term start only; the application portal is open 1 June – 15 October of the year before the programme starts.
